result.markdown:
For a small customer support team, my top recommendation is **Freshdesk**\. It offers a strong balance of affordability, ease of use, ticket management, automation, and room to grow.

However, the best choice depends on whether your team mainly handles email tickets, live chat, phone support, or a combination.

## My recommendation

For a small team of roughly 3–10 support agents\:

| Your priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Best all-around help desk | Freshdesk |
| Simple email support | Help Scout |
| Lowest cost | Zoho Desk |
| Advanced support operations | Zendesk |
| Live chat and AI | Intercom |


I wouldn't automatically choose Zendesk for a small team. You may end up paying for complexity you don't need.
